0|113e6b7e15e23dc45d5c66eb66bb91a627812e36|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"libbpf: Sanitise internal map names so they are not rejected by the kernel
The kernel only accepts map names with alphanumeric characters
and periods in their name. However
used by libbpf takes their prefix from the user-supplied BPF object name
which has no such restriction. This can lead to ""Invalid argument"" errors
when trying to load a BPF program using global variables.
Fix this by sanitising the map names
